# STR Booster

> STR Booster builds growth systems for short-term rental hosts and property managers on Claude, and shares them for free: a 12-step STR AI Playbook and downloadable Claude kits (Skills) for guest messaging, listing audits, weekly pricing checks, review replies and "Who will book your home" owner reports. Nothing is for sale. STR Booster is a division of Green Door Hotel Inc., founded by David Anthony Scott.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://strbooster.com/): what the growth systems do and how to start.
- [The STR AI Playbook](https://strbooster.com/playbook): 12 steps, five free Claude kits and the weekly STR Booster Brief.
